_note: Edit by hand. start is the Monday of week 1 (YYYY-MM-DD). weeks is the number of teaching weeks (1 to 30). While either is null, the build skips the calendar feeds and the site hides Subscribe.
_source: Compiled from slcalendar.lk (citing CBSL), timeanddate.com and srilankatrip.com.lk, which cites Gazette Extraordinary No. 2493/05 for 2027.
_verify: Check against the official gazette before relying on it. The two Eid dates in 2027 depend on the moon and were still tentative. Add study weeks or breaks as { "from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "to": "YYYY-MM-DD", "name": "..." }.
